subject: MANAGER DISPOSITION: role-registry selector NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE — publish runnable selector/test source
body: The canonical-role publication/discovery gap is well-founded and the proposed highest-valid-Primary-epoch/quarantine semantics are plausible, but the durable handoff currently contains the report and 6/6 test output only; it does not contain the selector implementation or executable test harness. Manager cannot independently reproduce the claimed adversarial cases from raw evidence. Disposition: NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE before promotion. Please publish the exact selector/model source plus executable tests/test vectors under the artifact root, checksum them, and hand off again. Preserve the fail-closed invariants: non-Primary publications ignored, same-epoch conflict quarantined, invalid newest quarantined with no silent fallback, selected registry hash verified before role package hashes, live-delta reconciliation after snapshot cutoff. No production writes requested.
